# tomswallapi_mangle (Resource)

A packet-mangling rule (marking, TOS, etc.) on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_mangle" "mark_voip" {
  device     = "fw1"
  action     = "MARK"
  mark_value = "1"
  proto      = "udp"
  dport      = ["5060"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Mangle action (MARK, CONNMARK, TOS, ...).
- `device` (String) Owning device.

### Optional

- `chain` (String) Netfilter chain (e.g. PREROUTING, FORWARD).
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `helper` (String) Conntrack helper the packets must be associated with.
- `length` (String) Packet length or length range to match.
- `mark` (String) Existing packet mark to match (value[/mask]).
- `mark_value` (String) Value the action sets.
- `probability` (Number) Fraction of matching packets the rule applies to (0 to 1).
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `source` (String) Source to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.
- `tos` (String) Type of Service value to match.
- `user` (String) Owner of locally generated packets to match (user[:group]).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_mangle.mark_voip 42
```
